program.name: PPL Plus
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Push, pull and legs, plus a fourth day for arms and shoulders, in supersets.
program.about: The classic push, pull and legs split with a fourth day for arms and shoulders, all in supersets so the sessions stay dense. Push pairs chest with triceps, pull pairs back with biceps, legs pairs squats with hinges, and the fourth day pairs raises with curls and extensions. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
